rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) with no third-party involvement is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Wind event last weekend removed approximately four shingles from the back porch overhang. No interior water damage reported. Policyholder estimates $400 in repair costs. Note: claim amount falls below the $2,500 policy deductible.

case_facts.description: Wind blew four shingles off overhang; no interior water damage
